description: This PHP source file defines a controller class Upgrade6 within an Opencart installation upgrade module. The class contains an index method that performs database updates and extension configuration changes during the upgrade process, specifically for version 6. It modifies settings and extension entries in the database, handling exceptions and preparing the subsequent upgrade step link.

classes.name: Opencart\Install\Controller\Upgrade\Upgrade6
classes.description: Controller class responsible for upgrading settings and extensions during version 6 of the Opencart installation process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executing the upgrade steps: updating extension settings, adding default extensions, handling errors, and redirecting to the next upgrade step.
